title: Identity Center instance declaration
description: access/identity-center/configuration/instance.yml - declaration-and-verification data, never a claim that this repository creates or owns the instance lifecycle (ADR-0005; T22 #21 d1-d2). Exact field set; unknown fields rejected (CFG-FIELDS). No live identifier field exists in this schema.

instance_type.description: Closed vocabulary; an account instance is rejected (T22 #21 d1; CFG-VOCAB).

primary_region.description: Must equal the T15 #10 d3 value; instance.yml is the sole regional authority (CFG-REGION).

additional_regions.description: Must equal the T15 #10 d3 value (CFG-REGION).

type.description: Governed vocabulary, extensible only by a future governed decision; the current vocabulary holds exactly identity-center-default (T22 #21 d2). The selected-slice profile narrowing carries P-OOS-IDENTITY-SOURCE.

delegated_administrator.description: An inventory alias in the established alias grammar; a declared prerequisite only - this repository never performs registration (T22 #21 d1; T16 #11 d6).

owner.description: A T06 #8 principal key; the responsible owner of the manual prerequisites. Resolution against the ownership registry is the validator's GOV-OWNER check.

verification.description: Optional and structurally all-or-nothing: absent means unverified; when present both fields are required (T22 #21 d1; CFG-VERIFICATION). Binding, freshness, and snapshot checks live at plan/apply (PRQ-*), never here.

verified_at.description: The exact RFC 3339 UTC body.discovered_at string of the referenced snapshot - an informational projection, never an independent freshness clock; byte-equality is enforced at plan/apply. Fractional seconds accepted when present.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot content digest - exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; the binding reference to the current binding snapshot.
